title: Cutting Styles
welcome_lead: Julienne, dice, brunoise — chef cutting words.
meta_desc: KS3 food: cutting styles, sizes and uniformity.

concepts.def: Rolled leaves cut into thin ribbons.

walkthroughs.body_html: Dice are cube cuts. Large dice ~ 2 cm, medium ~ 1 cm, small ~ 5 mm. Brunoise is super-tiny dice (2-3 mm) — used in fancy garnishes.
Julienne is thin matchstick strips — about 5 cm long and 2-3 mm thick. Used in salads, stir-fries, garnishes.
Pieces cut to the same size cook evenly. Big chunks plus small ones = small bits burn while big ones stay raw. Uniformity = professional cooking.
